session_narrative: Rally practice. Ten minutes of crosscourt forehands each side, then some down-the-line, then a serving set. I served four double faults across the serving set, which was maybe 20 serves. Toss felt a little inconsistent, arm felt a little slow. Just an off day. Maya's forehand looked huge.
take_away: Off day on the serve. Don't overthink it. Rally quality was fine.
